owner_rule: Use natural title-style/first-letter capitalization for primary creative headlines and major labels where grammatically appropriate. Do not mechanically uppercase everything. Do not default important headlines to sentence-style lowercase.
fixed_case_note: The public wordmark is always 'Advantage.Bid' (3M rule). The lowercase URL form is never drawn as copy; the footer wordmark is a locked brand-frame constant outside this function.

always_capitalize: verbs (including Is, Are, Be, Do, Can, Will, Has)
subordinating conjunctions (If, Because, Than, As, That)
both parts of a hyphenated compound (On-Site, Two-Day, Mid-Century)
the word after a colon or an em dash
title_case.apostrophes: It's, You'll, We're — capitalize the first letter only; never 'It'S'
title_case.ampersand: kept as typed; 'Fine Art & Antiques Auction'
title_case.numerals_and_dates: Saturday, September 19 · 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM (AM/PM uppercase by convention)
title_case.trailing_period: an Owner-style headline may end with a period; the engine preserves the period the copy source carries and never adds one to an event type or a label ('Estate Sale', never 'Estate Sale.')

roles: eyebrow/kicker (e.g. ADVANTAGE.BID PRESENTS — the locked 3M brand-frame constant)
uppercase_allowed.rule: uppercase is a small-label device; it is never applied to a headline, an event type or an event title

never: sentence-case a headline ('It's built to be easy.')
change the internal casing of a brand or proper noun
capitalize a preposition mid-line because it 'looks stronger' ('You Can Do This' keeps 'Do' capitalized because it is a verb, not because of emphasis)

tests.in: create your own online auction on Advantage.Bid.
tests.out: Create your own online auction on Advantage.Bid.
